title: Docs: Clear up .md links across site and modify docs-writer skill to future-proof

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable bug description detailing how anchor links with the '.md#' extension fail to resolve properly on GeminiCLI.com, alongside a request to update the docs-writer skill to enforce this standard for future documentation.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix involves updating markdown documentation files across docs/ to remove '.md' from relative anchor links and updating guidelines in .gemini/skills/docs-writer/SKILL.md, requiring no complex code refactoring or test infrastructure changes.

summary.problem: Anchor links formatted as 'XXX.md#ANCHOR' in documentation files do not resolve correctly when hosted on GeminiCLI.com, directing users to raw '.md' files instead of navigating to page anchors.
summary.root_cause: Documentation files use relative links containing '.md' extensions prior to section anchor hashes, and .gemini/skills/docs-writer/SKILL.md lacks explicit rules regarding anchor link syntax.
summary.context: Removing the '.md' extension before anchor fragments across docs/ and updating .gemini/skills/docs-writer/SKILL.md ensures compatibility across both GitHub and GeminiCLI.com.

steps: Update .gemini/skills/docs-writer/SKILL.md under the Links section to instruct writers that anchor links must omit the '.md' file extension before section hashes (e.g., 'file#anchor' instead of 'file.md#anchor').
Scan docs/ and replace all occurrences of '.md#' in relative links to remove the '.md' file extension before the anchor fragment.
Run npm run format to ensure updated markdown and MDX files conform to repository formatting standards.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Anchor links resolve correctly both on GitHub and GeminiCLI.com without routing to raw markdown files, and docs-writer skill guidelines prevent future '.md#' link usage.
verification_steps: Perform a grep search across docs/ to confirm no relative links contain '.md#' patterns.
Run npm run format to confirm formatting checks pass.
